name: emby-player
description: An iOS-styled Emby/Jellyfin desktop client with MPV core and multi-line racing.
author: Hills Lite Contributors

scripts.build: npm run check:secure-credentials && npm run check:electron-security && npm run check:local-decode && npm run check:no-planned-ui && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.electron:preview: npm run check:electron-commands && npm run build && npm run build:electron-helper && electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.electron:build: set ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.electron-builder-cache&& npm run check:electron-commands && npm run build && npm run build:electron-helper && electron-builder --win dir && npm run check:electron-package
scripts.electron:dist: set ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.electron-builder-cache&& npm run check:electron-commands && npm run build && npm run build:electron-helper && electron-builder --win portable && npm run check:electron-package && npm run check:electron-dist
scripts.tauri:build: tauri build --features mpv-embedded && npm run check:tauri-package
